source.householdIncome: U.S. Census Bureau, CPS Table H-8, 2023 median household income
source.estimatedFrom: HUD FY2025 income limits (24 CFR 982.201) and Census CPS Table H-8, 2023 household income. ESTIMATED FROM AVERAGE: state HUD areas represent unread local areas; unread jurisdictions use the median of the 50 compiled HUD state limits and 51 CPS household medians. Missing household income is estimated, never recorded as wages or zero.
source.adultIncome: HUD adult household income reporting; 24 CFR 5.609. Income of members below this age is used where recorded; missing child wages are not assumed.
